entryWatch.setup: TGT post-earnings DAY-2 continuation off the 8/19 gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - the candidate this board named IN ADVANCE yesterday, specified today at a 159.36 limit for 2 shares
entryWatch.trigger: ARMED, RE-QUOTED AT 12:22 AND CONFIRMED LIVE UNTIL 15:30 ET - AND THE LIMIT HAS NOW SLIPPED BELOW THE BID, WHICH IS A FURTHER STEP AWAY FROM A FILL AND IS REPORTED AS ONE. TGT is 159.41 bid / 159.53 ask at 16:22:40.785Z, last trade 159.47, a 0.12 spread or 0.075% of mark - the tightest this name has quoted all session, tighter again than last hour - against the 159.00 official settled close, so it is +0.26% on the bid and 0.59 ABOVE the 158.82 bid the entry was struck on at 09:47. THE 159.36 LIMIT IS NOW 0.05 UNDER THE 159.41 BID. Three hours, three positions: through the offer and filling on entry at 10:24, inside the spread and resting at 11:22, below the bid and waiting at 12:22. THE LEVEL IS STILL ON THE TAPE AND THAT IS WHY IT IS CONFIRMED RATHER THAN KILLED. Six of the twelve five-minute bars since the last check printed lows at or under 159.36 - 159.170, 159.145, 159.145, 159.270, 159.290 and, most recently, 159.330 in the 12:15 bar, seven minutes before this quote. The hour's range is 159.145 to 160.060. What has to happen for a fill is one 0.05 tick down in the bid, and the tape has supplied that repeatedly within the hour. BOTH INVALIDATIONS ARE UNTOUCHED. The early warning is a trade below 154.58, today's opening-bar low; nothing has traded below it since, and the lowest low of the twelve bars since the 11:22 check is 159.145, leaving the bid 4.83 or 3.03% clear - the widest cushion the spec has carried today. The outright void is a close below 152.48, 6.93 below the bid and untestable before the bell. THE LIMIT IS NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED. An hourly reading this at 13:17 needs only the tape and three numbers: 159.36, 154.58 and the 15:30 expiry.
entryWatch.why: CONFIRMED, AND THIS IS THE HOUR THE KILL TEST HAD TO BE DECIDED IN WRITING RATHER THAN WAVED THROUGH, BECAUSE LIMB TWO IS MET ON ITS FACE IN THE AWAY DIRECTION FOR THE FIRST TIME. A specification dies when its invalidation triggers, when its limit is no longer inside the spread, or when the setup it described has left the tape. Limb one fails: 154.58 has not been retested and the bid is 3.03% above it. Limb three fails: the gap-down, shake-out, reclaim structure is intact and the name is at a session-long equilibrium rather than trending away. LIMB TWO IS MET WORD FOR WORD - 159.36 is not inside 159.41/159.53 - and unlike the 10:24 reading, where the limit sat outside the spread on the MARKETABLE side and the operator would have paid less than specified, it is now outside on the AWAY side, which is the shape of a name that got away. IT DOES NOT FIRE, AND THE REASON IS EVIDENCE RATHER THAN RELUCTANCE. That limb exists to kill a level the tape has abandoned. The tape has not abandoned this one: it traded through 159.36 seven minutes ago and in half the bars of the last hour, on a 0.12 spread. Five cents of drift on a name whose hourly range is 0.92 wide is oscillation, not departure. THE BRIGHT LINE IS NAMED SO THE 13:17 RUN DOES NOT HAVE TO RE-DERIVE IT, AND SO THE RETRO CAN OVERRULE IT ON THE RECORD: the away-side kill for this entry is the level ceasing to print. If a full hourly window passes with no five-minute bar trading at or below 159.36, the tape has left the level and the specification should be killed rather than left resting to expire at 15:30. That is a test of the tape, not of the quote at one instant. THE FIVE CENTS ARE REFUSED AS THE EIGHT WERE. Meeting the bid at 159.41 would restore an immediate fill for ten cents across two shares. A limit may never be raised to chase, and the cheapness of the chase is the argument FOR the rule - this is the third consecutive hour the same five-to-seventeen-cent temptation has been declined, and declining it is the only reason the number in this row still means what it meant at 09:47. IT IS ALSO NOT LOWERED. The 159.36 stands as written for a fifth consecutive reading, and the operator is told plainly that it is now a resting bid under the market, not a fill.

entryWatch.setup: SQM post-earnings day-2 continuation off a 13% beat with a deliberately tepid day-1 reaction - ranked second today and passed over on liquidity
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 12:22 AND STILL AHEAD OF THE NAME THAT WAS BOUGHT, THOUGH THE GAP STOPPED WIDENING THIS HOUR. SQM is 77.40 bid / 77.57 ask at 16:21:19.899Z, last 77.50, +2.68% against the 75.38 settled close, against TGT's +0.26% on the same tape. That is 2.42 points of relative performance, essentially unchanged from the 2.80 of an hour ago - SQM gave back 0.21 while TGT added 0.10. The 0.17 spread is 0.219% of mark, narrower than the 0.373% of an hour ago but still nearly three times TGT's 0.075%, which is the liquidity gap it was ranked second on.
entryWatch.why: IT IS NOT CHASED, AND THE REASON IS THE RULEBOOK RATHER THAN THE SCOREBOARD. This slot is exits-only, the bar for a mid-session entry is higher than the open's by design, and the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text - it was discharged at 09:47. Even if this were the open slot, item 2 refuses it: a name up 2.68% on day 2, quoted 1.13 above the 76.27 day-2 high the open recorded, is being bought after the move rather than on the reclaim. The whole reason TGT was taken is that it had faded back to its own strike. KEPT VISIBLE SO THE RETRO CAN GRADE THE PREFERENCE HONESTLY. If SQM finishes ahead of TGT today the open's ranking was wrong on outcome and right on process, and the record should be able to say both. Passing over a name that then runs is the ordinary cost of ranking on liquidity.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings continuation - the thesis this board specified on 8/18 and again on 8/19, both expired unexecuted, now broken on its own written level
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND A 0.25 BOUNCE OFF THE HOUR'S LOW CHANGES NOTHING. AS is 32.80 bid / 32.83 ask at 16:22:39.041Z, last 32.82, -3.59% against the 34.02 settled close, recovering part of the 32.55 print of an hour ago. That is still 0.90 BELOW the 33.70 early warning the 8/19 entry wrote in advance and 1.04 below the 33.87 limit that expired unexecuted. A PARTIAL BOUNCE INSIDE A BROKEN STRUCTURE IS NOT A REPAIRED THESIS, and it is exactly the shape that would tempt a revival if the level had not been written down first.
entryWatch.why: IT IS NOT RE-STRUCK CHEAPER, AND THIS HOUR TESTS THAT REFUSAL IN THE HARDER DIRECTION THAN THE LAST ONE DID. When the name was falling it was easy to say the dead level was dead; a bounce is when a revival starts to look like judgement. The answer does not change with the direction of the tick. The higher low the day-2 thesis rested on broke at 33.70 and nothing since has rebuilt it - 32.80 is a lower low bouncing, not a base. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away; the mirror rule is that a level may not be revived because the name came back toward it after the structure broke. Had this board revived 33.87 when the name first returned to it, the position would be 1.04 underwater and heading for its own written invalidation.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, now ABOVE its dead limit for the first time
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED FOR A TWENTY-FIRST TIME AND THE PRICE HAS KEPT GOING THE OTHER WAY. SMCI is 35.70 bid / 35.71 ask at 16:22:40.013Z, last 35.705, -2.41% against the 36.58 settled close and down another 0.38 in the hour. The dead 38.24 limit is now 2.53 ABOVE the offer, having been 2.14 above it an hour ago and 0.78 BELOW it two hours ago. The name has traded 2.31 away from its own dead level inside a single morning.
entryWatch.why: THE PRICE COMING BACK WAS NEVER THE CATALYST RETURNING, AND TWO HOURS HAVE NOW SUPPLIED THE PROOF TWICE. At 10:24 this row said a lower price has never supplied the catalyst item 1 wanted; by 11:22 the higher price it was refusing had evaporated; by 12:22 the name is 2.41% red on the day. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5 - no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now seven sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet - and no amount of price movement in either direction repairs a missing catalyst. SMCI appears nowhere in the live 2026-08-19 to 2026-08-26 calendar. It keeps its place on the board for liquidity alone, on the second-tightest quote here at 0.028%, and is passed over for a name whose item 1 passes on a print one session old.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 3 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 12:22 AND MAKING NEW LOWS RATHER THAN A BASE. KLAR is 13.92 bid / 13.93 ask at 16:22:37.502Z, last 13.925, -5.47% against the 14.73 settled close and a further 0.15 below the 11:22 read - a third consecutive down day, now 0.40 through the 14.32 level this row carried, grinding lower each hour it is checked. A base is the precondition any entry here would need and none has formed in three sessions of trying.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18; three sessions on, AS is -3.6% today and KLAR is -5.5% on top of -22.5%. Neither beat is paying. WMT beat this morning and sold off nearly nine percent, AAP beat by 27% and lost a fifth of the company. That is the whole argument for reading a catalyst together with positioning rather than counting it on its own - and it is the argument this hour's TGT confirmation is resting against, which is why it stays in front of the operator rather than being pruned as noise.
